title: Professional Email Domain and Hosting Integration Settings
content:
How each Professional Email product works with Harborline domains and Harborline hosting.

| Product | MX, SPF, DKIM and autodiscover records set up automatically for a Harborline domain on Harborline DNS | cPanel mailboxes of a Harborline hosting plan stay active for the same domain once this subscription takes over MX |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | Yes | No |
| Harborline Mail Plus | Yes | No |
| Harborline Mail Pro | Yes | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | Yes | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | Yes | No |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | Yes | No |

## Notes

- Automatic record setup is a setting of every Professional Email product; it is used where the email domain is a Harborline domain on Harborline DNS.
- On no product do hosting-plan cPanel mailboxes keep running for a domain once the email subscription has taken over that domain's MX.
